answer_1.quote: We evaluate UniXcoder on five tasks over nine public datasets, including two understanding tasks: clone detection and code search, two generation tasks: code summarization and code generation, and an auto-regressive task: code completion.
answer_1.outputs: Generated code snippets, natural language summaries of code, and completed lines of code.

answer_2.quote: We use the smoothed BLEU-4 as the evaluation metric for code summarization, exact match accuracy and Levenshtein edit similarity for code completion, F1-score for clone detection, MAP for code search and zero-shot code-to-code search, and MRR for code search.
